adjudication_rationale: The boot-time check shares its gap with every pooled query run before the listener binds: libpq has no client-side query deadline and the pool relies on server-side statement_timeout (server/core/src/pg/pg_pool.hpp:81; server/core/src/server.cpp:11087-11088 on origin/dev). The fix belongs in PgPool and is already tracked as DevNullLtd/Yuzu#7304 (same root cause, measured there with a paused backend). This PR documents the limit (server.cpp comment, pg_collation_recheck.hpp, server-admin.md, upgrading.md) and closes the shutdown half (join moved last in stop(), commit 9188a42c1e). Evidence comment posted on #7304: https://github.com/DevNullLtd/Yuzu/issues/7304#issuecomment-6852123991. The boot-wait window against a frozen backend remains until #7304 lands.

summary: Results. CH-5: a REFRESH with no reindex cleared the mismatch gauge in 60 s and the clearing INFO said 'compares versions only; it does not show that the indexes were rebuilt'. CH-6: recorded set / actual NULL stayed Unreadable (unreadable counter 4 in 190 s, one WARN, REFRESH failed with 'invalid collation version change'), the catalog UPDATE to NULL produced one not-applicable INFO and no gauge series, and writing the value back was not noticed within 75 s (the settled cadence is hourly; docs now say so). CH-2(a): with the connection held on the check's own statement the server never bound its listener (45 s), a termination signal ended it at once, and releasing the connection after 40 s let the boot complete (47 s). CH-1: with only the check's connection held, SIGTERM ran every earlier stage in about 3 s (leader resign, offload and webhook drain, audit-write wait) and the process waited at the recheck join, the last step (thread dump: the check thread in PQexecParams inside check_collation_version, the main thread in PgCollationRecheck::stop at server.cpp:12472). A whole-backend pause (docker pause) instead hung earlier, in pre-existing stages that need the database (policy-eval and other background thread joins), which the join move cannot help. Method error found and corrected during the run: a first freeze matched a statement another store also sends and held that store's query; the final runs match 'datcollversion', which only the check sends.
